about:
Twisted Iron Fabrication LLC operates from New Brighton, Pennsylvania, serving Western Pennsylvania and neighboring states including Ohio and West Virginia. The custom metal fabrication shop does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The shop provides in-house powder coating, press brake forming, and custom metal fabrication for architectural and industrial applications. Its work ranges from residential and commercial railings to custom industrial equipment, trucking and machinery parts, and signage. The company does not publish facility size, employee count, or production volumes.

Customers span architectural, industrial, trucking, machinery, and signage sectors. The shop serves residential and commercial clients for indoor and outdoor railings, as well as industrial clients needing fabricated and powder-coated parts for equipment and vehicles.

The company emphasizes in-house powder coating to maximize efficiency and provide accurate lead-time estimates, positioning clear communication and reliability as core to its customer relationships.
